overall: The AG found the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by convening in executive session on March 8 under Purpose 3 to discuss litigation strategy with counsel. Public hearing and unfiled allegations were declined.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged the March 8 executive session under Purpose 3 was improper because no pending or threatened litigation justified it.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Board permissibly convened in executive session on March 8 to discuss strategy with respect to litigation that was pending, clearly and imminently threatened, or otherwise demonstrably likely.

allegations.summary: Complaints alleged the Board received information privately during the special permit public hearing, did not disclose it, and did not read documents into the record.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we decline to review, and offer no opinion regarding, whether the Board complied with various public hearing requirements when considering the special permit.

allegations.summary: Requests for further review raised additional allegations that were not included in the original complaints filed with the Board.
allegations.key_passage: we decline to review those allegations as they were not raised in an original Open Meeting Law complaint filed with the Board.
